what: Logo and page name are stacked on top of each other in the center cell of the fixed header, 2 seconds after the page opens the logo slides up 100% out while the name rises from below (.6s cubic-bezier(.19,1,.22,1)). After that, scrolling down shows the name and scrolling up shows the logo — the moment scroll direction changes they swap places over the same duration

options.delay: Initial time until switching to the name (sec), default 2
options.dur: Transition duration (seconds), default .6 — also settable via css --fx-dur

note: Cell height is given by the user (the child fills the cell and is centered). With reduced motion the name is shown immediately

from.where: shared.js .sw-head__switch — original .identity--archive (animation slideUpLogo/slideUpTitle .6s cubic-bezier(.19,1,.22,1) 2s forwards, then if body.dir-bottom the logo translateY(-100%) · name 0)
